navigation.contract: Real click navigates to the expected destination route (Back to Journey, Previous, Next, sidebar links). No persistence required (navigation is the state change itself).

selection-toggle.contract: Real click toggles a selection on/off (aria-pressed true/false), used for hotspot zones, cigar/shape/cut pickers, decision-support selections. Selection is ephemeral UI state; persisted only via the Continue action into journey context.

rating-toggle.contract: Real click sets a rating/observation flag (aria-pressed), persisted into journey-context localStorage on every change (not just on explicit Save), surviving a full page reload.

tab-disclosure.contract: Real click on a role="tab" (or equivalent disclosure) element reveals additional real content that was not previously rendered — verified as an actual content-length increase, not decorative.

tasting-input.contract: Real click toggles a flavor/aroma/intensity selection on/off (aria-pressed), feeding a client-state flavor/tasting profile object.

completion.contract: Real click on Continue/Complete/Claim triggers the done-flag guard (`if (done) return`), preventing a rapid double-click from producing two navigations/awards, then navigates to the correct next screen.

honest-disabled.contract: When a prerequisite is not met (e.g. no mentor selected), the screen renders an honest empty/disabled state with no fabricated content, and no interactive control that would falsely imply availability.

inventory.label: Sign out — return to SmokeCraft landing
